propositions: On PASS-path reuse (idempotent_reuse), the returned verdict synthesizes empty blocking/advisory/coaching/indeterminate lists instead of replaying the stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar content, causing the CLI to output zero counts and lose prior findings.
BLOCK-path reuse (verdict_reuse) correctly replays stored findings and a reused notation, but PASS-path reuse does not achieve feature parity.

When plan review skips re-run due to unchanged plan, the output must unmistakably state that findings are the last review's result replayed (not a fresh LLM run), reference --force to re-review, and include the stored review's recency anchor (verified_at_sha or timestamp) if available.

The PASS-path reuse must read and replay the latest REVIEW_RESULT sidecar's advisory/coaching/indeterminate and counts when the sidecar matches the current material fingerprint, with fail-open degradation to empty lists if sidecar is absent, unreadable, mismatched, or contradictory.
